overview.intro: From your first free service to warranty repairs and periodic maintenance, our I-9/3 workshop keeps your Hyundai running the way it left the factory. Hyundai-trained technicians, genuine parts, and a clear estimate before any work begins.

facility.intro: Hyundai Islamabad’s showroom and service workshop share one site off 9th Avenue in I-9/3, so you can choose, buy and look after your Hyundai in one place.
facility.showroom: Explore the current Hyundai line-up and talk through prices and EMI plans with our sales team.
facility.workshop: Free services, periodic maintenance, mechanical repairs and body & paint work, carried out by Hyundai-trained technicians.

ownerManuals.intro: Get to know your Hyundai inside out. Each Owner’s Manual covers controls and features, driving tips, the maintenance schedule and warranty information for your model.
ownerManuals.note: Manuals are large PDF files, so we recommend downloading them over Wi-Fi.

customerPromise.intro: We pledge to provide outstanding service and go above and beyond to surpass your expectations.
pledges: Listen attentively and actively follow through on your requests.
Uphold a clean, safe, and welcoming environment.
Greet you promptly upon arrival with a friendly and professional demeanor.
Provide precise time and cost estimates.
Seek your authorization before commencing any additional work.
Thoroughly explain all repairs performed and review all associated costs.
Ensure your vehicle is returned to you as agreed upon, in a clean and orderly condition.
Initiate contact within three business days to confirm your satisfaction with all the services provided.

maintenanceCharts.intro: Stay on top of your Hyundai’s upkeep with our periodic maintenance chart. It shows how often each item should be replaced, model by model.
maintenanceCharts.note: Intervals are a guide for normal driving. If you drive in severe conditions, follow the shorter schedule in your Owner’s Manual, or ask our service advisors.

freeServices.intro: Every new Hyundai comes with three free scheduled services at an authorised Hyundai dealership. The labour is free; you only pay for any parts, lubricants or accessories that are needed.

services.title: First free service
services.detail: Your first check-up, carried out to the schedule in your Owner’s Manual. Our technicians inspect the vehicle after its running-in period and make any adjustments it needs.

services.title: Second free service
services.detail: A scheduled service following the Owner’s Manual guidelines. Labour is free; parts, lubricants or accessories are charged only if they are required.

services.title: Third free service
services.detail: Your last complimentary service, again carried out to the Owner’s Manual. You only pay for parts, lubricants or accessories that are used or needed during the service.

warranty.intro: A written promise from Hyundai Nishat Motor to repair or replace any component that develops a fault because of a defect in material or workmanship, within the warranty period.

coverage.title: New vehicle limited warranty
coverage.detail: Covers every component of your new Hyundai, apart from the exclusions below, for 48 months from original retail delivery or first use, whichever comes first, up to 100,000 kilometres.

coverage.title: Paint warranty
coverage.detail: Covers paint defects and surface corrosion (not perforation) caused by faulty paint material or workmanship, for 24 months from original retail delivery or first use, up to 50,000 kilometres.

coverage.title: OEM warranty
coverage.detail: Tyres, batteries and audio-navigation units are covered by their own manufacturers’ warranties. See the warranty condition card supplied with your vehicle for details.

warranty.service: Authorised Hyundai distributors and dealers carry out warranty repairs free of charge for both parts and labour. Warranty work done anywhere else is not covered.
warranty.claims: Hyundai makes the final decision on all warranty claims.
warranty.covered: Repair or replacement of any component originally manufactured by Hyundai that proves defective in material or workmanship under normal use and maintenance, except for the items listed under What is not covered.

notCovered.title: Normal maintenance
notCovered.detail: Routine servicing is not covered: inspections, tightening and adjustments, engine tune-ups, fuel-system adjustments, wheel alignment and balancing, cleaning, lubrication, oil changes, tyre rotation, and topping up fuel, oils, fluids, coolant, refrigerant or washer fluid. These are covered only when a replacement is needed because of a defect in material or workmanship.

notCovered.title: Normal wear and deterioration
notCovered.detail: Wear and consumable items are covered only when their replacement is caused by a defect in material or workmanship.
items: Spark plugs
Brake pads and linings
Clutch linings and discs
Wiper blades
Filters
Bulbs and fuses
V-belts

notCovered.title: Damage or failure caused by
items: Not carrying out the maintenance required in the Owner’s Manual
Misuse, abuse, overloading, accident or theft
Flooding or fire
Incorrect or insufficient fuel, fluids or lubricants
Parts that are not Hyundai Genuine Parts
Devices or accessories not supplied by Hyundai
Modification, alteration, tampering or improper repair
Normal ageing of rubber parts, upholstery and soft trim
Minor irregularities that do not affect quality or function, such as slight noise or vibration, or traits characteristic of the vehicle

notCovered.title: Incidental and consequential costs
notCovered.detail: Costs that follow from a fault are not covered, for example fuel, phone calls, travel, lodging, meals, vehicle rental, storage, lost time or pay, inconvenience, commercial loss, or loss of use of the vehicle.

notCovered.title: Other exclusions
items: Any vehicle whose odometer reading has been altered
Airborne or industrial fallout, acid rain, salt, hail, sandstorms and other natural events
Paint scratches, dents and similar paint or body damage
Stone chips in paint or glass from sand, gravel, dust or road debris
Paint defects caused by the cargo compartment (trucks only)

owner.title: Use and maintain it properly
owner.detail: Follow the Owner’s Manual for use, maintenance and care, including the severe-driving maintenance schedule if it applies to how you drive.

owner.title: Keep your service records
owner.detail: Keep a record of every scheduled service. You may need it to show that the required maintenance was carried out.

owner.title: Use an authorised Hyundai dealer
owner.detail: For warranty work, bring your vehicle to an authorised Hyundai dealer during regular service hours.

owner.title: Inspect it at delivery
owner.detail: Check the trim, paint and overall appearance when you take delivery of your new vehicle.
